priorityList: Use Warrior of Elune on cooldown
Apply Sunfire, Apply Moonfire, and Stellar Flare (if talented)
Cast Celestial Alignment if you have just cast Fury of Elune unless saving to line up with Convoke the Spirits
Cast Convoke the Spirits if you have cast Celestial Alignment and have less than 40 Astral Power
Enter Lunar Eclipse if not entering cooldowns
Cast Fury of Elune if not entering Celestial Alignment
Cast Starsurge to spend Astral Power
Cast Starfire to generate Astral Power
Cast Starfire inside Celestial Alignment on single target due to Lunar Calling
Enter Solar Eclipse or Enter Lunar Eclipse
